== Exact preview and issued wording ==
The July preview bars the character from participating in battle on her deployment turn. The issued card instead limits your initiation of battle at her deployment site. The preview’s qualifying Jedi Lightsaber deploys and fires for free, and the preview gives Sniper immunity. The issued text makes lightsaber swings free and protects the character from being won in sabacc. Opponent-site Force icons, attrition immunity and three printed end-of-turn options carry forward. The spoiler names Droid Merchant as the backing. The surviving issuer face and sleeve margin each print three dots. Both sources give the same power, ability, destiny, deploy, forfeit, Warrior marker and character classification.
